products.overview: Watching a reaction happen is worth more than analyzing it after the fact. NMReady-Flow is built to make that possible without a dedicated flow-NMR system. It's a flow-cell kit that converts a Nanalysis benchtop NMR into an online reaction-monitoring detector, usable standalone or alongside other analytical techniques already in your lab. The flow-through cell installs easily, can be sealed from the environment, and experiments can be started on-board, through NMReady-CONNECT, or via third-party software, whichever fits how your lab already works.

faqs.question: What is NMReady-Flow used for?
faqs.answer: NMReady-Flow is a flow-cell kit that converts a Nanalysis benchtop NMR into an online reaction-monitoring detector. It's used for studying chemical reactions in real time as they progress.

faqs.question: Which instruments is NMReady-Flow compatible with?
faqs.answer: NMReady-Flow is compatible with both the Nanalysis-60 and Nanalysis-100 benchtop NMR spectrometers.

faqs.question: Can NMReady-Flow be used alongside other analytical techniques?
faqs.answer: Yes, NMReady-Flow can be used as a standalone reaction-monitoring tool or in conjunction with other analytical techniques already in your lab.

faqs.question: How is the NMReady-Flow cell installed?
faqs.answer: The NMR flow-through cell is designed to be easy to install and can be sealed from the environment during use.

faqs.question: How do I control experiments on NMReady-Flow?
faqs.answer: Experiments can be initiated directly on the instrument, remotely through NMReady-CONNECT, or through third-party software, depending on your lab's setup.

faqs.question: Can NMReady-Flow automate repeated syntheses?
faqs.answer: Yes, NMReady-Flow supports automating repeated synthesis runs, reducing the need for manual sampling at each stage.

faqs.question: Does NMReady-Flow integrate into a larger laboratory system?
faqs.answer: Yes, NMReady-Flow is built to integrate the benchtop NMR into a broader laboratory system rather than operating as an isolated step.

faqs.question: What is the price of NMReady-Flow in India?
faqs.answer: The price of NMReady-Flow in India depends on your instrument compatibility and control setup. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of NMReady-Flow in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Nanalysis NMReady-Flow in India. Inkarp provides demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

Reactions can be understood and optimized in real time, rather than through periodic sampling and offline analysis.
Repeated syntheses can be automated, reducing the manual sampling that normally comes with monitoring a reaction over time.
The flow-through cell is easy to install and can be sealed from the environment, protecting the reaction stream during monitoring.

sections.title: Real-Time Reaction Monitoring
body: Sampling a reaction after the fact tells you where it ended up. Watching it in real time tells you how it got there, and that's the shift NMReady-Flow is built around.

Once installed, the flow-through cell turns the benchtop NMR into a continuous, online detector, letting you understand and optimize a chemical reaction as it actually progresses, rather than reconstructing it from periodic offline samples. That same setup extends naturally to automating repeated syntheses, since the instrument can monitor each run without needing manual sampling at every stage.

rows: Protecting the reaction stream during monitoring

groups.note: Tell our team about the reaction or synthesis process you want to monitor, and Inkarp will confirm how NMReady-Flow fits into that workflow.

groups.description: A flow monitoring setup only helps if it fits how your lab actually operates, and NMReady-Flow is built to adapt to that rather than the other way around.
body: Experiments can be started directly at the instrument for hands-on control, remotely through NMReady-CONNECT for teams that need to check in from elsewhere, or through third-party software for labs that already run their own automation or control systems. That flexibility is also what makes it possible to integrate the benchtop NMR into a larger laboratory system, rather than keeping it as a standalone step disconnected from the rest of the process.
